Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 32 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anita - 55 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anil - 65 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Anita and Anil stand near him.]

Suresh: "What lovely weather!"

[Suresh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Suresh (softly): "Exactly right."

[Suresh waits at the zebra crossing and then crosses the road.]

Anita (surprised): "And then?"

Scene 2: The office - Day

[Suresh stands in the office. Anita and Anil stand near him.]

Suresh: "Let's begin."

[Suresh has a heart attack at his desk.]

Suresh: "Careful!"

[Suresh answers the phone at his desk.]

Suresh: "That's easy."

[Suresh stretches after hours at the computer.]

Anil: "How beautiful!"

[Suresh presses the lift button and waits.]

Anil (gently): "Show me too!"

[Suresh checks his watch impatiently.]

Suresh: "Let's see."

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Suresh is asleep in bed in the ward. Anita and Anil stand near him.]

Anil: "Let's begin."

[Suresh dies peacefully in his sleep.]

Anil (laughing): "No… this cannot be!"
